mechanism.notes: slipper-nose's mechanism with the nose / flank sliding pair replaced by the RSSR: an O3 Ti rod (+1 moving body) with two M2 ball links (+2 joints, 3 rotations each, minus the rod's idle spin = +5 passive rotations); the nose-flank joint and its rotation removed (-1 joint, -1 passive rotation, -1 sliding pair): bodies 6, joints 9, loops 9 - 6 = 3 (the wearer loop, the lobe loop link 1b - link 2 - crank, the RSSR loop link 1a - K - link 1b - crank - rod). The crank's EAR is a joggled tab of link 1b (same part); the radial ball stud is the same M2 ball link screwed into the arm's end face. Custom +2 (rod, horn lug), catalogue -1 dowel +2 ball links (the long-stroke row's counts, joints corrected 10 -> 9 so the topology flag is clean).

verdict: SCREENED - the drive's metal is no longer the cost (7.57 -> 0.29 points on the frozen bench), but with a leak-free pick the row is at PARITY with slipper-nose, not ahead: frozen exact 18.87 (score 93.14) / held out 23.21 vs 18.49 / 23.45 (paired pooled -0.06, 90% CI [-0.44, +0.39], P 0.55); robust build 18.83 / 23.16. The fit bench picks the short K dyad (26 / 38 / 59) and kK 1.79: the long-dyad steep-law lever does not survive fit-bench-only selection.
limiter: The chain, not the drive: fold 88 of 360 (= slipper-nose's 88), K used 45.8 deg. With the drive's metal deleted the pick is 18.58 - every remaining point is the chain's. The leak-free fit objective (2 mm near-touch, Bench(60,160)) does not select the steep law / long dyad (cma1 a / d seeded there: 18.45-18.60 vs 16.47); a jittered workspace-envelope search bench (CLAUDE.md, not yet built) is the instrument that could.

red_team.jam: no dead centre inside the range: the RSSR range scan stops at transmission 48 (PA 42 at both ball ends); over the taken K (<= 46.4 deg) the transmission stays >= 52.0 (PA <= 38.0). The radial crank-tip stud's socket tilt peaks at 25.5 deg over the taken range (25.9 robust) against the 30 deg cone assumed for an M2 ball link: a 25 deg (short-neck) socket would bind at the top of the taken range - buy a long-neck stud / +-30 deg link, or fall back to the axial stud (secondary cma1 f: 18.21 / 23.42).

liftoff.stage2: rod with two ball links: bilateral, cannot lift off
liftoff.stage1: lobe follower held by the K clock spring as the lead (0.08 N.m preload + 0.015 N.m/rad): static factor 0.08 / 0.033 (exo weight about K) = 2.4; a cuff force cannot drive the chain's self-motion (K vs q2 at a fixed arm pose)
